# Agentic phone

Place AI voice calls across vendors from CLI, SDK, or MCP.
Package: agentic-phone 0.1.0. Node.js >=18. MIT.
SDK: placeCall, createCallGuards, vendor adapters, consent log helpers.
CLI: call, log, costs, mcp, help, version.
MCP: place_call, get_consent_log, get_cost_report.
Preview is the default. Live needs a live flag and an environment API key.
Every call needs an AI disclosure and an E.164 destination.
Default day hours: 08:00 to 20:00 UTC.
Successful live calls record consent and one dispatch cost unit.
See README.md for options and examples.
